'''''Holcus annuus''''', called '''annual fog''', is a species of flowering plant in the grass family [[Poaceae]], native to the [[Mediterranean region]] and the [[Transcaucasus]], and introduced to southeastern Australia.<ref name="POWO_404972-1" >{{cite POWO |id=404972-1 |title=''Holcus annuus'' Salzm. ex C.A.Mey. |access-date=1 January 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://vro.agriculture.vic.gov.au/dpi/vro/vrosite.nsf/pages/sip_annual_fog |title=Annual Fog |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=23 March 2020 |website=Victorian Resources Online |publisher=State of Victoria (Agriculture Victoria) |access-date=1 January 2023 }}</ref> In spite of its scientific and common names, it is a perennial.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp05397 |title=''Holcus annuus'' |last1=Clayton |first1=W.D. |last2=Vorontsova |first2=M.S. |last3=Harman |first3=K.T. |last4=Williamson |first4=H. |date=8 August 2005 |website=GrassBase - The Online World Grass Flora |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=1 January 2023 }}</ref>
